respond to this persons commnt: Melissa Gann Cornwell
🤦‍♀️ if we were making $500,000 we wouldn’t need you!

Haha I hear you Melissa 😅 but honestly, most of the spas we work with are already doing decent revenue… they’re just stuck or feeling maxed out.

It’s usually not about needing more clients, it’s about what’s slipping through the cracks. Missed follow-ups, low show rates, no real system to increase what each client is worth.

That’s exactly why we built the playbook. It’s meant to help you make more from what you already have, not just push you to $500k.

If you want it, I’m happy to send it your way 😊
